data.long_meaning: The name 'Kanaiya' is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of two words: 'Kana' meaning 'Lord Krishna' and 'Iya' meaning 'Servant' or 'Dedicated To'. This name signifies devotion and dedication to Lord Krishna. The name Kanaiya carries the meaning “Servant of Lord Krishna” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanaiya usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of lord krishna and live with faith, good character and purpose.
